title: Ruff, Roar & Rejoice!
description: A fun Jeopardy game made just for little ones! Learn about Avengers heroes, cool animals, Bluey's family, brave Bible champions, songs that praise Jesus, and your favorite cartoon pups and bunnies.

questions.question: This Avenger is the son of Odin, the king of the gods! He has a magical hammer called Mjolnir and can make thunder and lightning in the sky!
This tiny Avenger can shrink down super small — as small as a real ant! He talks to ants and calls them his friends!
This Avenger does not have magic powers, but he NEVER misses! He uses a bow and arrow to help protect people.
This Avenger wears a yellow and black suit and can fly like a bee! She can also shoot tiny lightning bolts to stop the bad guys.
This Avenger wears giant red wings on his back so he can fly through the sky! He is also a very good friend of Captain America.
This big golden animal lives in Africa. It has a fluffy mane around its face and makes a very loud ROAR! It is called the king of the jungle.
This yellow bird lives near ponds and lakes. It says QUACK! It can swim in the water AND fly up in the sky!
This little green animal starts its life swimming as a tiny tadpole! Then it grows four legs and learns to hop and says RIBBIT!
This beautiful bug starts out as a fuzzy caterpillar, then wraps itself in a cozy cocoon, and comes out with gorgeous colorful wings to fly!
This big furry animal loves to eat honey and fish! When winter comes and it gets very cold, it finds a cozy cave and sleeps all winter long.
This little Blue Heeler puppy loves to play pretend games with her family and friends. The whole show is named after her!
This is Bluey's younger sister. She is a red and orange puppy and Bluey's very best friend in the whole world!
This is Bluey and Bingo's dad! He loves to roll around on the floor and play all kinds of silly games with his daughters.
This is Bluey and Bingo's mom! She works hard every day and also loves to play, hug, and take care of her little puppies.
Bluey's whole family has a last name that is also the name of the type of dog they are. Their family name is the Heeler family. What kind of dog is Bluey?
This brave woman in the Bible became a queen and saved all of her people from a very mean man named Haman. God used her to do something amazing!
Moses had a big sister who watched over him when he was a baby floating in a basket on the river! She also played a tambourine and danced to celebrate God!
God helped this man win a huge battle with only 300 soldiers! They used torches and clay jars instead of swords, and God gave them the victory!
God called this young boy's name three times in the night while he was sleeping! He became a great helper who listened to God and served the people of Israel.
This incredibly strong man in the Bible never cut his hair — that was the secret to his amazing strength! He could even wrestle a lion. His name rhymes with the word 'hambone.'
This worship singer writes amazing songs to praise God and is famous for a song called 'This Is Amazing Grace.' His first name is Phil.
This singer makes beautiful Christian music and also writes special songs just for kids to help them worship God! Her first name is Ellie.
Phil Wickham wrote this powerful song about Jesus rising from the dead and giving us hope forever. It is called 'Living blank' — what is the missing word?
Ellie Holcomb wrote a beautiful song about God making a path through scary times, just like when Moses walked through the parted water. The song is called 'Red Sea blank' — what is the missing word?
Both Phil Wickham and Ellie Holcomb make this special kind of music — songs that praise Jesus and help whole families worship God together. What do we call this kind of music?
This brave boy is the leader of the PAW Patrol! He calls all the puppies together whenever there is a rescue mission. His name is Rye-der!
This German Shepherd puppy in PAW Patrol wears a police uniform and badge. He loves to be a good helper for everyone in the community!
This spotted Dalmatian puppy in PAW Patrol is a fire pup AND a medical pup! He sometimes trips and falls, but he always jumps up to help his friends!
In the movie Zootopia, this little bunny works really hard to become the first ever bunny police officer! She shows everyone that ANYONE can be anything they want to be.
In Zootopia, this sneaky but kind fox becomes best friends with the bunny police officer. He learns to be honest and uses his cleverness to help instead of trick!
